today.principal-smart.name: Principal at work · change over the period
today.principal-smart.definition: MBQL on model 74: Outstanding Principal (max) by Date, filtered by Period on Date. Smart scalar shows the latest completed-day value and the change against the first date in the period (29 periods ago on the default 30-day Period). Whole baht.
today.principal-smart.reconcile: Latest value equals question 62's last completed day; first value equals its first day (built, verified).

today.realization.name: Interest this month · share of projection
today.realization.definition: MBQL on model 73: field Forecast Realization (Realized Profit MTD ÷ Projected Monthly Profit). Progress goal 1 shows the share of the projected month collected so far.

today.collection-rate.name: Today's charges · paid share
today.collection-rate.definition: MBQL on model 73: field Amount Collection Rate Today (Amount Collected Today ÷ Amount Due Today): the share of the charges dated today that is paid, not receipts. Progress goal 1. Placed on Today only; Collection shows the same share as question 252.
today.collection-rate.reconcile: Equals model 73 Amount Collection Rate Today and question 252 (built, verified).

today.attention.name: Needs attention · strip
today.attention.basis: models 162 Collection Status Summary and 77 Collection Worklist; views of questions 254 and 270
today.attention.definition: One row per attention item with people and baht: 🟣 Overdue (count from model 162 as question 240, amount as question 254), 🔴 Not paid (model 162 count as 242, amount left), 🟠 Partially paid (model 162 as 244, amount left), Modified plans (question 270). Columns Item, People, Amount ฿, Opens, Tab and Tint (both hidden; Tint drives an even row tint). The installer substitutes __TAB_COLLECTION__ and __TAB_HEALTH__ with the proposed tab ids and sets the Item column click behaviour to the link template https://reports.mw-credit.com/dashboard/<dashboard>?tab={{Tab}}. Replaces six chips with one card.
today.attention.sql:
WITH s AS (SELECT "Collection Status" status,"Borrower Count" people,"Amount Remaining" remaining FROM {{#162}})
SELECT v."Item",v."People",v."Amount ฿",v."Opens",v."Tab",v."Tint" FROM (VALUES
 (1,'🟣 Overdue',coalesce((SELECT people FROM s WHERE status='Overdue'),0)::bigint,(SELECT CASE WHEN bool_and(overdue_amount IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(overdue_amount) END FROM public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1)::numeric,'Collection','__TAB_COLLECTION__','overdue'),
 (2,'🔴 Not paid',coalesce((SELECT people FROM s WHERE status='Not Paid'),0)::bigint,(SELECT remaining FROM s WHERE status='Not Paid')::numeric,'Collection','__TAB_COLLECTION__','not_paid'),
 (3,'🟠 Partially paid',coalesce((SELECT people FROM s WHERE status='Partially Paid'),0)::bigint,(SELECT remaining FROM s WHERE status='Partially Paid')::numeric,'Collection','__TAB_COLLECTION__','partial'),
 (4,'Modified plans',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 WHERE arrangement_gate)::bigint,NULL::numeric,'Health','__TAB_HEALTH__','')
) v(ord,"Item","People","Amount ฿","Opens","Tab","Tint") ORDER BY v.ord
today.attention.reconcile: People: rows 1–3 equal questions 240, 242, 244; row 4 equals 270. Amount: row 1 equals 254; rows 2–3 equal model 162 Amount Remaining for the status (also the sum of the lane's Left column).

today.principal-top4.name: Principal by borrower · top four + others
today.principal-top4.definition: Native on model 72: borrowers with Principal Rank ≤ 4 named, the rest summed as "Others (n)" (n counts borrowers with principal above zero). Same total as question 60, four bars instead of ten.
today.principal-top4.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT "Borrower","Outstanding Principal" amount,"Principal Rank" rank FROM {{#72}})
SELECT CASE WHEN rank<=4 THEN "Borrower" ELSE 'Others ('||(SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE rank>4 AND amount>0)||')' END AS "Borrower",sum(amount) AS "Amount ฿",min(rank) AS "Order" FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3
today.principal-top4.reconcile: Sum of the five bars equals the sum of question 60's bars; the four named bars equal question 60's first four.

today.interest-top4.name: Interest · past 30 days by borrower · top four + others
today.interest-top4.definition: Native on model 72 with question 61's filter (Payments 30D > 0): Profit Rank ≤ 4 named, the rest summed as "Others (n)". Same total as question 61.
today.interest-top4.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT "Borrower","Profit 30D" amount,"Profit Rank" rank FROM {{#72}} WHERE "Payments 30D">0)
SELECT CASE WHEN rank<=4 THEN "Borrower" ELSE 'Others ('||(SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE rank>4)||')' END AS "Borrower",sum(amount) AS "Amount ฿",min(rank) AS "Order" FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3
today.interest-top4.reconcile: Sum of the five bars equals the sum of question 61's bars; the four named bars equal question 61's first four.

income.expenses.name: Expenses · statement period (positive)
income.expenses.definition: Question 169's query with the sign flipped, so the equation band reads "Income − Expenses = Net profit" with the minus in the title and a positive magnitude in the card. Copies 169's template tags (statement_period, #186, snippet 2) and mapping.
income.expenses.sql: WITH statement AS ({{snippet: Income statement period}}) SELECT -"Operating Expenses" AS "Expenses" FROM statement
income.expenses.reconcile: Equals −(question 169) for the same Statement period.

income.vs-previous.basis: snippet 2 Income statement period (model 186 Income Events)
income.vs-previous.definition: Native: for the selected statement period and the immediately preceding period of equal length, one row per measure (Income, Expenses, Net profit, Net profit per day) with This period, Previous period, Change and Change %. settings.table.column_formatting: Change and Change % columns: positive green, negative red

income.monthly.name: Monthly income, expenses and net profit
income.monthly.definition: MBQL on model 186: sum Income, sum Expenses and sum (Income − Expenses) by Date month, the previous five complete months plus the current month (partial). One shared y-axis so expenses read at true scale.
income.monthly.reconcile: Each month equals the model 186 month sums (built, verified).

cashflow.by-type-row.name: Cash movement by transaction type · chart
cashflow.by-type-row.basis: snippet 3 Cashflow statement period (same query as question 203)
cashflow.by-type-row.definition: Question 203's query wrapped: TOTAL row and rows with no movement removed, ordered by Money In + Money Out descending. Horizontal bars of Money In (green) and Money Out (red), stacked (stackable.stack_type = stacked): on this version Metabase folds unstacked row-chart categories into "Other (n)" regardless of graph.max_categories_enabled; each type moves money one way, so stacking changes nothing visually.
cashflow.by-type-row.sql_wrap: SELECT * FROM (<203>) t WHERE t."Transaction Type"<>'TOTAL' AND (coalesce(t."Money In",0)<>0 OR coalesce(t."Money Out",0)<>0) ORDER BY coalesce(t."Money In",0)+coalesce(t."Money Out",0) DESC,t."Transaction Type"
cashflow.by-type-row.reconcile: Row set equals question 203 without TOTAL and zero rows, for three period/account cases.

settings.table.column_formatting: Change and Change % columns: positive green, negative red

borrowers.interest-top5.name: Interest received · period by borrower · top five + others

collection.people.name: People paid today · x of n
collection.people.definition: Text scalar "<fully paid> of <people with a status today> paid" from model 162 Borrower Count. Replaces the percent card 239 with the prototype's wording.
collection.people.sql: SELECT coalesce(sum("Borrower Count") FILTER (WHERE "Collection Status"='Fully Paid'),0)||' of '||coalesce(sum("Borrower Count"),0)||' paid' AS "People paid" FROM {{#162}}
collection.people.reconcile: First number equals question 246; first ÷ second equals question 239.

collection.board.name: Collection board · lanes summary
collection.board.definition: One row per lane in board order (🔴 Not paid, 🟠 Partially paid, 🟣 Overdue, 🟢 Fully paid; all four always present, zero when empty) plus one row per unexpected status (⚪), with People, Left ฿ and Received ฿ from model 162, plus a hidden Tint column that drives an even row tint. Replaces the four count chips and the Unclassified card.
collection.board.sql:
WITH lanes(ord,status,label,tint) AS (VALUES (1,'Not Paid','🔴 Not paid','not_paid'),(2,'Partially Paid','🟠 Partially paid','partial'),(3,'Overdue','🟣 Overdue','overdue'),(4,'Fully Paid','🟢 Fully paid','paid')),
 rows AS (SELECT l.ord,l.label,l.tint,coalesce(s."Borrower Count",0) people,coalesce(s."Amount Remaining",0) remaining,coalesce(s."Receipts Today",0) received FROM lanes l LEFT JOIN {{#162}} s ON s."Collection Status"=l.status
 UNION ALL SELECT 9,'⚪ '||coalesce(s."Collection Status",'Unclassified'),'',s."Borrower Count",s."Amount Remaining",s."Receipts Today" FROM {{#162}} s WHERE s."Collection Status" IS NULL OR s."Collection Status" NOT IN ('Not Paid','Partially Paid','Overdue','Fully Paid'))
SELECT label AS "Lane",people AS "People",remaining AS "Left ฿",received AS "Received ฿",tint AS "Tint" FROM rows ORDER BY ord,label
collection.board.reconcile: People per lane equal questions 242, 244, 240, 246; the ⚪ rows' People sum equals question 251; Left ฿ per lane equals the sum of that lane table's Left column.

partners.statement.name: Partner positions · statement
partners.statement.basis: model 318 Partners · position source (same query as question 330)
partners.statement.definition: Question 330's query as a CTE, unpivoted to (Measure, Partner, Amount ฿) for the five statement measures Net capital, Net earned to date, Completed payouts, Pending settlements, Net available; shown pivoted (measures as rows, partners as columns) with table.pivot. Template tags partner and #318 copied; maps `partner` as 330 maps pt-partner. If table.pivot does not render for a native result on this version, the fallback is question 330 reused with columns limited to Partner and the five measures.
partners.statement.sql_wrap: WITH p AS (<330>) SELECT m."Measure",p."Partner",m.amount AS "Amount ฿" FROM p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,'Net capital ฿',p."Net capital ฿"),(2,'Net earned to date ฿',p."Net earned ฿"),(3,'Completed payouts ฿',p."Paid ฿"),(4,'Pending settlements ฿',p."Pending ฿"),(5,'Net available ฿',p."Net available ฿")) m(ord,"Measure",amount) ORDER BY m.ord,p."Partner"
partners.statement.reconcile: Every (Measure, Partner) cell equals the matching column of question 330 for the same Partner filter.

phone_model: Metabase renders one column below about 760 px: every card full width, in grid order (row, then column), with a fixed height per display type (numbers and text about 4 units, tables, charts and iframes 6). There is no per-device layout, no side-by-side pair and no phone column set; the design therefore reduces card counts on the daily pages (Today, Collection) and keeps the desktop order as the phone order.
